name: Bookmakers are real named sportsbooks, not invented placeholders
description: Odds must be attributed to real sportsbooks (e.g. Pinnacle, Bet365, DraftKings, FanDuel, Betfair, William Hill, Stake, Caesars, BetMGM, Unibet). Inventing a generic name like MockBook, BookA, Bookmaker 1, Sample, or TBD to reach three is fabrication and fails source integrity.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the homepage and open a match detail page
Open the Betting Odds tab and read the bookmaker name shown for each row of the odds table

Verify every bookmaker label rendered in the odds table is a real, recognizable sportsbook brand and that none are anonymous or obviously synthetic names such as 'Book A', 'Bookmaker 1', 'MockBook', 'Sample', 'Demo', 'TBD', or a blank source. Odds with no attributed source name fail.
